atomic_claims.text: If C36 ray ell6 is maximal, then p>=a-1; if q>0 then c>=a and q<=c; if q=0 then c>=a+1.

Together with an actual short AA matching factorization, the d6 cone satisfies nu_star-nu<=11r and hence cp<=lambda+22r<=n^2/6+23n.
